report.headline: Most likely cause: checkout-svc - checkout-svc configuration change to use a new payment service port causing timeout errors

ranked_causes.mechanism: checkout-svc configuration change to use a new payment service port causing timeout errors
payment-svc version 2.4.2 has a bug that causes it to not handle checkout-svc requests properly
network misconfiguration causing checkout-svc to connect to payment-svc on an incorrect port

claims.text: checkout-svc configuration changed to use port 18112 for payment service
checkout-svc version 1.8.2 deployed with commit f27c07f
